data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 16.6m (2014: favourable development of GBP 10.9m); this comprises releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business, GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business and Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a favourable prior year development (net of reinsurance) of GBP 16.6m in respect of claims outstanding for prior years, driven principally by releases in Third Party Liability and smaller releases in Aviation, Reinsurance acceptances and other direct business. The report provides only net (after reinsurance) prior year movement numbers; a gross prior year movement is not stated in the notes and the gross claims development triangle is not provided, so a gross PYD figure cannot be reliably determined from the disclosure.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development of GBP 16.6m (2014: favourable development of GBP 10.9m)
releases of GBP 16.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 0.3m in respect of direct Aviation business

Other direct business releases of GBP 0.1m
data.data_quality_notes: The report provides the prior year movement only on a net (after reinsurance) basis (GBP 16.6m favourable). A gross prior year development figure is not stated. The claims development triangle included in the report is explicitly labelled 'net' (net undiscounted ultimates). Therefore a reliable GROSS prior year development amount cannot be computed from the available disclosures; prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null.
